reason: Follow-up to #612: operator help gains an absolute relevance requirement. An article qualifies for an operator message only when at least 15% of one query's content words (after stop and failure words, with a light plural/tense stem) name its topic (title and keywords); the #612 relative floor then applies among qualifying articles. Final synthesis searches failed-step receipts with observed_failure=True (chat _tool_operator_help), which keeps the #612 behaviour there. Scoring and ranking are unchanged. Selected: operator-help ranking tests (new negatives generated with the retention eval's scenario generator, chatty runbook questions, the failed-receipt path, and a chat-level status-note/failed-step test), test_chat.py and the reference-material tests (help citations), the tool loop (synthesis help path), and knowledge retrieval/timing tests that run prepare with retrieval. Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI or visible change. tests/test_context_retention_eval.py excluded: the eval script is unchanged; the new test only imports its scenario generator. test_packaging.py excluded: the bundled operator_help.md corpus is unchanged. No full suite.
